highlights.title: These are real live fares
highlights.body: Every option here came from a live flight search, not from the model's imagination. Voygent only writes real, sourced inventory into a trip.

highlights.title: One shortlist from many suppliers
highlights.body: These hotels come from several travel vendors, deduped and ranked into a single curated shortlist so you compare like for like.

highlights.title: It patches the trip instead of rewriting it
highlights.body: Each change is a small incremental patch to the saved trip, not a full rewrite. That keeps every turn cheap. The engineering panel counts the tokens saved.

highlights.title: It finds open days and fills them
highlights.body: Voygent spots gaps in the itinerary and suggests excursions to fill them, including commissionable tours the advisor earns on.

highlights.title: It builds the daily itinerary automatically
highlights.body: The trip lays out day by day with timed activities, not just a pile of bookings. The advisor adjusts from there.

highlights.title: Value past the bookable items
highlights.body: Inclusions, local dining picks, and good-to-know notes round out the proposal, so the client gets a finished plan, not just flights and a room.

highlights.title: A full planning session for pennies
highlights.body: Model routing and context discipline keep spend low. This is measured routed cost for the whole run, not an estimate.

highlights.title: It caught a problem and fixed it
highlights.body: A trip-integrity check found something off in the projected trip and repaired it in place. The panel logs the check honestly, pass or repaired.
